answer: The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 25 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. Because the ridge beacon round is committed in advance, the terrace audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, since the sonnet value does not exist until the window has already shut. That is 11 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
